groups.title: Slip rolls · value line
groups.lead: Electric slip rolls for sheet to 1/4″ — NovoTech value line, built in China.

intro_add: For sheet, NovoTech's value-line ESR electric slip rolls, built in China, roll 22 ga to 1/4″ with cone rolling for the HVAC and sheet-metal shop.
points_add: NovoTech value line: ESR electric slip rolls 22 ga – 1/4″

faq_add.a: A slip roll is a light three-roll machine for sheet — duct, flues, tanks, hoppers, signage — in 22 ga to 1/4″, with a top roll that swings out to slip the finished cylinder off. A plate roller rolls heavier plate and pre-bends the edges so the cylinder closes round. The HER hydraulic slip rolls, with the hydraulic 3-roll plate rollers, bridge the two, to 1/2″ over 6′7″.

set.hero_brand_line: ISITAN machines are made in Turkey by ISITAN Makine — sheet-metal forming machinery since 1959, with European components; NovoTech's value-line slip rolls are built in China to NovoTech's specification. All sold, installed and supported in Canada by NovoTech.
